evidence.source: Raport privind starea învățământului preuniversitar din România 2022–2023
qualitative_findings: Non-realisation of the professional/dual schooling plan was attributed mainly to graduates choosing liceal education rather than professional/dual pathways.
Employer involvement in professional training includes human/material resources for practice, work/protection equipment, joint development of practice curriculum and ongoing student assessment.
The Ministry maintained a dedicated strand of information and counselling for increasing participation in professional education.
The career-orientation guide included professional and technological qualifications and career outcomes.
2024 development directions included updated qualifications linked to new technologies and labour-market demand, plus improved information/counselling for professional and dual education.
